description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, verifying its session matching logic, prompting behavior based on security and ask policies, and fallback decision logic involving allowlist patterns.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests that the prompt presents when the active session matches the request session.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Verifies fallback prompting based on recent activity timestamp.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Ensures that prompt presentation aligns with the current mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Tests that prompts are always shown when ask policy is always.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Tests that prompts only occur for allowlist security policies under onMiss ask policy.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Verifies that no prompts are shown when ask policy is off.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Checks that allowlist pattern matching allows the command when a pattern matches.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Checks that the command is denied if the resolved path does not match any allowlist pattern.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Verifies that fallback allows command execution when prompting cannot be performed.
